H+: Greater prior entrepreneurial experience of the founding team is associated with a higher number of acquisitions made by the venture before its exit.
H-: Greater prior entrepreneurial experience of the founding team is associated with a lower number of acquisitions made by the venture before its exit.
H+_range: Greater prior entrepreneurial experience of the founding team is associated with a higher number of acquisitions made by the venture before its exit, across the observed range of founding-team experience.
H-_range: Greater prior entrepreneurial experience of the founding team is associated with a lower number of acquisitions made by the venture before its exit, across the observed range of founding-team experience.
